day2_after_start.text:
*The last class ends and Eunsu approaches.*

Miss, does everything at school need the app? I thought I could just show my ID. Then I'll set up the app first.

day2_after_eunsu_1.text: Wi-Fi, the library, even the cafeteria QR code all go through the app.

day2_after_eunsu_2.text: It's the last step of your transfer registration. If you don't install it, your QR code won't scan starting tomorrow.

day2_after_eunsu_3.text:
*The store lists 'Hanul Smart Campus', rated 4.8.*

This one, right? The name matches.

day2_after_eunsu_4.text:
*I install it and open the student ID field.*

Where do I find my student number?

day2_after_eunsu_5.text: Here's your student number. The same number was on your desk, too.

day2_after_eunsu_6.text:
*The Post-it from my teacher already has a small check below the six-digit number. I enter it in the app.*

I'm in. What do I tap now?

day2_after_eunsu_7.text:
*When I entered my student number, permission requests appeared one after another.

[Location] Campus emergency location check
[Camera] Student ID QR
[Microphone] Emergency call*

I understand the camera for my ID. Can't the microphone switch on only during calls? Does it need my location all the time too?

day2_after_eunsu_8.text:
*A gray scrollbar remains below the permission window.*

There's more down there. Do I need all of them on?

choices: Change location to 'Only while using the app'

day2_after_allow_1.text: *I allow everything. I don't have the energy to go through the settings one by one.*

day2_after_limit_1.text: *App notification: 'Location permission is restricted. Emergency safety features will be disabled.'*

day2_after_limit_2.text: Set location to 'Always Allow.' It causes fewer problems on campus.

day2_after_limit_4.text: It changed after last year. The notification wording was added then too.

day2_after_limit_5.text: *The gray toggle on the settings screen turned blue. The app's `Safety Status` indicator at the bottom immediately turned green.*

day2_after_sea_1.text: You're here. The forms are over here.

day2_after_sea_2.text: I said I'd come. I found the council room too. I thought you'd come out if I waited at the door, but it was all right to come in, wasn't it?

day2_after_sea_4.text:
*Sea smiles. The hand she had been clenching under the desk loosens a little.*

Relax your hand. We haven't started yet; are you nervous? You're not worried I'll mess up the papers, are you?

day2_after_sea_5.text:
*Sports day paperwork covers the desk.*

All for sports day? That's quite a pile.

day2_after_sea_6.text: Sports day is next week. I need to organize the event programs and class applications.

day2_after_sea_7.text: Can I help? Just watching makes me feel bad. You can do the difficult parts; give me something simple to start with.

day2_after_sea_8.text: Is that so? Could you sort the applications by date?

day2_after_sea_9.text:
*Sea organized the event programs, and I sorted the application forms. The sound of turning pages continued steadily between us.*

By date, right? I'll keep the same day's together.

day2_after_sea_10.text: Look, Class 2 signed up for both tug-of-war and relay. Ambitious.

day2_after_sea_12.text: Our class... still hasn't turned theirs in. I need to collect them by tomorrow morning.

day2_after_sea_13.text: You can collect them tomorrow. Sorting won't make the missing ones appear. I don't think this is something you should rush over on your own.

day2_after_sea_14.text: I was supposed to collect at least half by the end of today.

day2_after_sea_15.text:
*Sea sets the application form on the desk.*

*After we have worked for a while, she puts on some music. It's the band from lunch.*

That's the song from lunch. You put it on while sorting too? The rustling papers are already enough for me.

day2_after_sea_16.text: When it's quiet, all you can hear is the paper.

day2_after_sea_17.text: *The sound of papers and music. Sunset light pours in through the window. Dust drifts slowly above the desk.*

day2_after_sea_18.text: {name}. Can I leave another chair out for you?

day2_after_sea_19.text: Wasn't there a spare chair here?

day2_after_sea_20.text:
*Sea looks out the window. Sunset falls across half her face. A single cup ring remains at the edge of the desk.*

There's only one cup mark. Do the other council members ever sit here?

day2_after_sea_21.text: There was, but no one ever sat there for long.

day2_after_sea_22.text:
*Sea tries to smile, but crumples the corner of the paper.*

I've only creased the paper. It's fine, I can smooth it out. I'm not blaming you, so don't look at me like that.

choices: "Wouldn't it go faster if we called the others?"
Pull out the chair without saying anything

day2_after_sea_23.text: Then, should we work here again tomorrow?

day2_after_sea_24.text: Yeah. I'll put your name on it so the applications don't get mixed up.

day2_after_sea_26.text:
*Sea starts writing my name on the label, then rewrites the letters a little smaller.*

It's still my name when you rewrite it. Won't it disappear among the forms if it's so small? You'll be the only one who can find it.

day2_after_sea_28.text:
I can hear the paper now. This should do.

*After that, we worked without a word. The music was one notch lower than before.*

day2_after_sea_invite_1.text: Wouldn't it go faster if the other student council members helped too?

day2_after_sea_invite_2.text:
*Sea looks back and forth between the two empty chairs without answering right away.*

There are empty chairs, but you're not answering. I thought more people helping would be good. You can say no if you don't want that.

day2_after_sea_invite_3.text: It's fine if it's just the two of us today. I'll keep your application separate.

day2_after_sea_invite_4.text: *I don't ask again. I pull out the chair.*

day2_after_sea_silent_1.text: *Instead of answering, I pulled a chair from the wall. Its legs scraped quietly across the floor.*

day2_after_sea_silent_2.text: Thanks. You can put it here.

day2_after_hallway_1.text: *Leaving the student council room, I walk down the hallway and find some classmates gathered by the vending machine.*

day2_after_hallway_2.text: Oh, {name}! What are you doing here?

day2_after_hallway_3.text: I was helping Sea in the student council room.

day2_after_hallway_4.text: Helping Sea? Already? You've only been here two days.

day2_after_hallway_5.text: Once the class rep gives you a job, you end up helping again and again.

day2_after_hallway_7.text: Hey, want something from the vending machine? I'll buy you one.

day2_after_hallway_8.text: Oh, it's fine. I'd like to go with you, but you don't have to pay. I'm still learning faces; getting free drinks already feels a little awkward.

day2_after_hallway_9.text: Come on, it's your first week. Take it.

day2_after_hallway_10.text:
Thanks. Where's good to eat nearby? Tell me about sports day too.

*I took the can of coffee milk. It was cold.*

*We chatted for a while—places to eat near school, class names for sports day, how fast our homeroom teacher graded. Things like that.*

day2_after_hallway_11.text: *I rolled the can in my hand. Cold coffee milk. The same flavor as the one I got yesterday.*

day2_after_seolhwa_1.text:
*As I am about to leave through the school gate, a prickling sensation runs across my back.*

*I stop and turn around.*

day2_after_seolhwa_2.text: *It's Seolhwa. Standing inside the gate, watching me. In the sunset light. Her long hair drifts in the wind over her uniform.*

day2_after_seolhwa_3.text: *I blink once. She's still there, watching me, sunset caught around her eyes.*

day2_after_seolhwa_4.text: *Her lips move. I can't hear a sound. Even though the wind is blowing toward me.*

day2_after_seolhwa_5.text:
*My throat goes dry. I take one step toward Seolhwa.*

What did you say? I can't hear you from here. I can only see your lips moving. Wait, I'll come closer.

day2_after_seolhwa_6.text: *A group of students passes between us, blocking my view for a moment. When I look again, Seolhwa is already walking away.*

day2_after_seolhwa_7.text: *Her retreating figure disappears across the schoolyard. She slips between the other students, but no one greets her.*

day2_after_seolhwa_8.text:
*Between the students' shoulders, I pictured where Seolhwa's empty desk had been.*

*Tomorrow, I'll look back before the bell rings.*
